# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c15 P4](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is a pale, spiritual-looking maiden with dark eyes. She has a vivid, dream-like charm.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c15 P4](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0004)_

## Personality

Priscilla is pale and spiritual-looking on the outside, but full to the brim of mischief, pranks, and fun. She has a poetic, thoughtful mind and enjoys nature and imaginative ideas. She is also a loyal and appreciative friend.

_Sources: [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067), [v2 c13 P75](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0075)_

## Traits

- Full of mischief, pranks, and fun  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>
- Thoughtful and imaginative  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067)</sub>
- Poetic and appreciative of nature  <sub>[v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011), [v2 c13 P75](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0075)</sub>

## Abilities

- Writing compositions and stories  <sub>[v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c7 P3](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0003)</sub>

## Goals

- To become famous  <sub>[v2 c13 P32](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0032)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley, where she formed a close friendship with Anne and Stella Maynard. After graduating, she secured a position as a schoolteacher in Carmody, and later took her own home school. During the summer, she arranged for her aunt, the famous author Charlotte E. Morgan, to visit the Island and spend time with Anne. She also joined Anne and her friends on a spring birthday picnic in the woods, participating in their Story Club and imaginative adventures.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P25](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0025), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c7 P3](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0003), [v2 c13 P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 c16 P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)_
